description: pydov is the Databank Ondergrond Vlaanderen Python package for machine access to Flemish soil, geology and groundwater information. It queries DOV services and converts responses to forms that can be used in modelling scripts. Inputs are geographic, depth or attribute search criteria; outputs are extracted subsurface records. The source coverage is Flanders, with time span and spatial precision depending on the selected DOV dataset. Source code is free under MIT terms, with package documentation and an installable PyPI release. The README makes clear that the data accessed through DOV has a separate service disclaimer, so the software licence does not by itself grant every downstream data use. pydov can prepare groundwater and geotechnical inputs for infrastructure simulations. It is a data client, not a groundwater model. The code and service documentation were reviewed, but no DOV records were queried or downloaded.
name: pydov Flemish subsurface data client
